cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before I tell you who won, which candidate were you hoping for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Ignore my face. It isn't your ballot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd never know whether your kindness voted with me.
